summary.text: Alissandra Murray is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 20 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Murray co-founded the Reproductive Freedom Fund of New Hampshire in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Alissandra Murray lives in Manchester, New Hampshire, and worked as deputy director of the Reproductive Freedom Fund of New Hampshire.
Murray's career experience also includes working as wellness and culture director for the New Hampshire Youth Movement and as a regional organizer for Rights & Democracy New Hampshire.
Murray and Candace Gibbons won the Hillsborough 20 general election on November 8, 2022, and Murray won re-election on November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists Murray's 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee, where Murray served as clerk.
